field_provenance.names_stats_types_rarity: GenshinData game-data extracts distributed by genshin-db
field_provenance.thumbnail: first-party HoYoverse image URL indexed by genshin-db, with an explicit Enka Network game-asset mirror fallback
field_provenance.ascension_region: derived from the first weapon-ascension material family; Nod-Krai/Far North are grouped under Snezhnaya

weapons.official_english_description: In the distant past, this was the beloved spear of a famed Inazuman bandit.

weapons.official_vietnamese_name: "Bá Vương Tối Thượng Siêu Cấp Ma Kiếm"
weapons.official_english_description: A magical sword that can only be wielded by the ultimate overlord who rules the seas. As it has been made with special water-resistant materials, it will not get ruined by water damage even after being immersed. Why, one might even call it invincible!
weapons.ascension_material: Broken Goblet of the Pristine Sea

weapons.official_english_description: An object of fantasy with countless definitions amidst an endless sea of stories. On the grand scale of the universe or the realm of dreams, there is no real difference between the holy sword of the brave warrior and the princess's teaspoon, or between the ice-cold clockspring and the key that will unlock the gates of transcendence...
weapons.ascension_material: Sundered Glory of the Far-North Scions

weapons.official_english_description: A greatsword that dazzles like the rising sun. It has witnessed the extinguishing and rekindling of innumerable suns.
This lamp illuminates the dreams that float up over a thousand nights, and in its emerald-green light flows a song of ancient days.
A rapier once wielded by a deceiver who had forsaken everything. In the past, it was primarily used as a tool when he had to disguise his identity.
The beloved sword of the legendary "Akuou." The blade is huge and majestic, but is surprisingly easy to wield.
weapons.ascension_material: Coral Branch of a Distant Sea

weapons.official_english_description: An intricate, opulent longbow. It once belonged to a gentleman thief who was never caught.
A blade custom made for a famed samurai who could strike down a tengu warrior, known for their incredible agility, in midair.
weapons.ascension_material: Coral Branch of a Distant Sea

weapons.official_english_description: An extremely ancient bow that has retained its power despite its original master being long gone. It draws power from everyone and everything in the world, and the further away you are from that which your heart desires, the more powerful it is.
A golden box as splendid as the light of the heavens. According to legend, it once belonged to a divine envoy of the Eternal Court.
Notes left behind by a top student. Many useful spells are listed, and the handwriting is beautiful.
This longbow's color is unpredictable. Under the light, it takes on a lustrous, watery blue.
The soul of the Knights of Favonius. Millennia later, it still calls on the winds of swift justice to vanquish all evil — just like the last heroine who wielded it.
A ritual vessel passed down amongst the Meztli. They say that this was once a treasure much-valued, yet never used, by the hero "Giant" Tupac.
An ancient longbow crested with red feathers, a sacred relic of the Flower-Feather Clan that has been passed down from generation to generation.
A precious sword gifted by the Day King to the brave hero in the little witch's story, only for the witch to take it and defeat the hero herself.
This blade was once pure and pristine as a white dawn star, but it has since been tinted a deep, dark blue.
An anthology of exquisite poetry. It contains quite a few poems beloved by Mondstadters, concerning the skies, dandelions, and other such topics.
A polearm used by those seeking to catch fish in the tundra. It lets none escape.
weapons.ascension_material: Broken Goblet of the Pristine Sea

weapons.official_english_description: A large, flat-tipped sword designed in to fit as the weapon of an ancient king or some ceremonial instrument.
A polearm as straight as a flag pole. Well suited to most combat situations, it has an imposing presence when swung.
An exceptionally powerful polearm that also offers a simple but elegant solution to the issue of the easily stained white tassel.
A mysterious catalyst made of a material known as "blackcliff." It has an ominous crimson glow that seems to pulse in synchronization with the tremors from deep within the earth.
A sword made of a material known as "blackcliff." It has a dark crimson glow on its black blade.
A weapon made of blackcliff and aerosiderite. There is a dark crimson glow on its cold black sheen.
An extremely sturdy greatsword from the Blackcliff Forge. It has a dark crimson color from the blade to pommel.
A bow made of blackcliff that features extremely sturdy bow limbs. It requires an archer with a strong bow arm to use.

A lantern that emits a faint, ghostly glow, contained by a midnight-black alloy that resembles interlocking bones. It is said to have once been revered as a precious treasure by a certain secret organization.
A greatsword passed down by the Luchkin. It is said that only the bravest warrior is qualified to wield it.
weapons.ascension_material: Rise of the Pale Star Army

weapons.official_english_description: A long spear tainted black by unrelenting battle, it shines with an ethereal glow beneath the ghostly blue light of lantern-fire.
A steel sword that is said to have been coated with dragon blood, rendering it invulnerable to damage. This effect is not extended to its wielder, however.

A ceremonial blade forged by Sanhaj, the great high priest of the Masters of the Night-Wind. In tales of bygone days, Sanhaj could use this curved blade to perform rituals, blurring the boundary between the Night Kingdom and the present world.
weapons.ascension_material: Delirious Decadence of the Sacred Lord

weapons.official_english_description: A keenly honed weapon forged from some strange crystal. Its faint blue light seems to whisper of countless matters now past.
A floating device that can monitor certain phenomena. It was picked up and modified to serve other purposes following its abandonment.
weapons.ascension_material: Broken Goblet of the Pristine Sea

weapons.official_english_description: A jade-adorned longbow. The gentle winds always seem to swirl gently about its string. Legends claim that this weapon was made in a far more ancient era by a dragon artisan.
A sword made from materials that do not belong in this world. The power within might even be able to withstand the corruption of a venom that could corrode a mighty dragon.

weapons.official_vietnamese_name: Trò Chơi Của Các Nhà Vua
weapons.official_english_description: A golden box lavishly inlaid with precious jewels. It houses a game much beloved by the kings of the sands.
weapons.ascension_material: Copper Talisman of the Forest Dew

weapons.official_english_description: A prototype for a standard-issue weapon the Yuheng commissioned from Blackcliff Forge after having analyzed the ancient mechanisms that protected the adeptal abode upon Tianheng.
An exotic metallic bow from a distant land. Though extremely difficult to maintain, it is easy to nock and fires with tremendous force.
A reliable steel-forged weapon that serves as a testament to the great adventures of its old master.
A longbow crafted to preserve order. Its cold radiance perfectly emanates the ideals of absolute fairness and justice.
weapons.ascension_material: Rise of the Pale Star Army

weapons.official_english_description: A fan carved from pure jade, around which swirls an ancient aura of adeptal energy.
An exotic weapon with an extremely long blade on the top and a crescent blade at the bottom. It found its way into Liyue through foreign traders. With practice, it can deal heavy damage.

A keen-edged weapon, luster dazzling as the crimson moon. It is said that an ancient dynasty once regarded it as a ritual object that could bridge two worlds, but none still remember the beliefs and ceremonies of that bygone age.
weapons.ascension_material: Broken Goblet of the Pristine Sea

weapons.official_english_description: A perfectly ordinary iron sword, just slightly darker than most.
A silver-forged ritual vessel, pure and completely without blemish. It is said to be a sacred relic passed down for generations among the priestesses of the far north.
A sharp crimson polearm that was once a gladiator's priceless treasure. Its awl has been stained by the blood of countless beasts and men.
A handy club made of fine steel. The most persuasive line of reasoning in any debater's arsenal.

weapons.official_vietnamese_name: Đối Thoại Của Hiền Giả Sa Mạc
weapons.official_english_description: A caduceus symbolizing the glory of alchemy, made from special alloys to match its special status. It is exceedingly rigid and heavy, and would probably hurt pretty bad if used as a cudgel.
weapons.ascension_material: Copper Talisman of the Forest Dew

weapons.official_english_description: A polearm forged from Whitestone and Starsilver. Its keen point is constantly enveloped in a bone-piercing chill.

weapons.official_vietnamese_name: Tuyển tập các câu chuyện về Dodoco
weapons.official_english_description:
A children's book filled with childish short stories at which one cannot help but laugh.
Even those readers who have long reached adulthood cannot help but be absorbed by the innocent, naive little adventures portrayed within.
A polearm decorated with an entwining golden dragon. Light and sharp, this weapon may very well kill dragons with ease.
A spear created from the fang of a dragon. It is oddly warm to the touch.
Youthful dreams and the thrill of adventure. If this isn't enough, then make it up with valiance.
A heavy blade that people claim was beloved by the hero known as the Firethief. They say that even the Lord of Cinder Keep's flames could not burn it away.
A Catalyst said to crystallize voice. Within it lies a sealed oath of loyalty, as well as a heart long since forgotten by mankind.
weapons.ascension_material: Rise of the Pale Star Army

weapons.official_english_description: A bow as lovely as any bard's lyre, its arrows pierce the heart like a lamenting sigh.
A longsword that is entirely gemstone, said to be crafted for the path of righteousness. When unsheathed, it glows with the luster of blue flame.
weapons.ascension_material: Rise of the Pale Star Army

weapons.official_english_description: A catalyst carved out of the hard jade from Jueyun Karst north of Liyue. Small, light, and durable, it is known more colloquially as the "jade ball."
This seems to be a now-extinct fish. Its body is sufficiently elastic that a string may be attached to it to let it serve as a bow.
A naginata used to "cut grass." Any army that stands before this weapon will probably be likewise cut down...
A lute whose golden strings are as radiant as sunlight. It appears to be a relic from the Seelie of old.
weapons.ascension_material: Sundered Glory of the Far-North Scions

weapons.official_english_description: A string of lovely jasper from the deep sea. It shines with a pure radiance like that of the moon, and just as ever-distant.
weapons.ascension_material: Coral Branch of a Distant Sea

weapons.official_english_description: A longsword that once shone with the light of the very stars. In the voyager's hand, it becomes a brand-new light that has nothing to do with any past era.
A dim black glaze pearl that is said to have the power to read the purity of one's heart.
A precious bow made of platinum, inlaid with an orb that shimmers with the light of eventide.
A giant sword forged from pure turquoise. Due to its greater weight than most ordinary weapons, it was named for Kongomato the Mountain King.
weapons.ascension_material: Delirious Decadence of the Sacred Lord

weapons.official_english_description: A secret tome that belonged to the scholars of the Knights of Favonius. It describes the logic and power of elements and matter.
A heavy ceremonial sword of the Knights of Favonius. It channels elemental power easily and is highly destructive.
A polearm made in the style of the Knights of Favonius. Its shaft is straight, and its tip flows lightly like the wind.
A standard-issue longsword of the Knights of Favonius. When you're armed with this agile and sharp weapon, channeling the power of the elements has never been so easy!
A standard-issue recurve bow of the Knights of Favonius. Only the best archers can unleash its full potential.

A replica of the famed sword of Arundolyn, the Lion of Light. Feel the power of a legendary hero as you hold this sword in your hand! Imagine yourself as the great warrior himself! Note: Daydreaming not recommended in live combat.
A creepy straight sword that almost seems to yearn for life. It drips with a shriveling venom that could even corrupt a mighty dragon.
A sharp filleting knife. The blade is long, thin, and incredibly sharp.
This longsword is as silent as the mysterious ocean depths. It is even more ancient than its stylings might imply.

Tribal tales tell of a great blade forged by the People of the Springs to protect a child who would embark on a distant journey. This particular weapon appears to be a replica of that legendary sword.
weapons.ascension_material: Delirious Decadence of the Sacred Lord

weapons.official_english_description: A handy length of abandoned copper pipe that was once used as a weapon. It was famous — or infamous, depending — in some circles.
A longbow that burns like a flame. The feathers that adorn it are said to have come from the ancient tyrant Ngoubou.
A strangely-shaped anthology of scripts. All the scripts written by Coppelius are recorded within.
A peculiarly shaped jade longsword that has been passed down amongst the Masters of the Night-Wind as a "priestly flute."
A keen polearm forged from jade. It gives off rainbow-hued light when exposed to sunlight.
weapons.ascension_material: Delirious Decadence of the Sacred Lord

weapons.official_english_description: A weapon you obtained from an Aranara tale. It has taken on the shape of a greatsword that shall cut down the foes of the forest.
weapons.ascension_material: Copper Talisman of the Forest Dew

weapons.official_english_description: A greatsword decorated in gold. Legend has it that it was the favored weapon of a certain exalted Harmost back in the distant past.
A spinning mechanical blade produced by the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop that seems to hide secrets from a bygone era...

weapons.official_vietnamese_name: Lời Thề Tự Do Cổ Xưa
weapons.official_english_description: A straight sword, azure as antediluvian song, and as keen as the oaths of freedom taken in the Land of Wind.
A fruit that possesses a strange, frosty will. A faint sense of agony emanates from it.
A spear of solid ice imbued with an icy chill. It is said that it once belonged to the Belyi Tsar who ruled Snezhnaya in the distant past.
weapons.ascension_material: Measured Pour of the Cellared Spiritual Nectar

weapons.official_english_description: A fruit you obtained from an Aranara tale. It holds the potential to conquer any crisis.
Bold Burkina from the Scions of the Canopy once made this weapon with the hero Tenoch's help — all for the sake of obtaining Flamegranates unmatched throughout Natlan.
Legend has it that this greatsword was forged by the hand of Ravenwood, who inherited the name of Boreas, prior to his ascension to knighthood.
A longbow carved from ancient whitewood, once, in ages past, wielded by the Jack Frost King of the northern lands.
A catalyst that carries the memory of the Kitsune Saiguu of ancient times. However, this device is but an impoverished vessel for the full breadth of her thought.
weapons.ascension_material: Coral Branch of a Distant Sea

weapons.official_english_description: A polearm with an axe blade mounted on top that can deal quite a lot of damage. It's favored by the Millelith officers.
A certain shrine maiden once owned this warbow. It was made with surpassing skill, and is both intricate and sturdy.
A famed work by the Futsu line of smiths. The name "Haran" comes from the manner in which it resembles the violent, roiling waves.
A sword that once shone like the sun. The wielder of this sword will be blessed with a "feel-good" buff. The reflective material on the blade has long worn off.

weapons.official_vietnamese_name: Lưỡi Kiếm Dung Luyện Dị Đoan
weapons.official_english_description: He drew this weapon once more when he first met that God of Flame, revered by all, but it had been too long since he had last used it.
A hunter's music consists of but two sounds: the twang of the bowstring and the whoosh of soaring arrows.
This gilded bow was made using precious white branches. It has felled countless wicked beasts attempting to infiltrate the woods.
A golden bow forged from the description in the story. If you use it as a normal weapon, you can also view it as a part of a fictional world that has made it off the pages.
weapons.ascension_material: Copper Talisman of the Forest Dew

weapons.official_english_description: Sharp and pointy at one end, it is a balanced weapon that is quite popular among travelers.
An exotic long-bladed rapier that somehow found its way into Liyue via foreign traders. It is light, agile, and sharp.
A longbow of immense strength. It shines with the radiance of dreams even in the darkest of nights.
A ritual vessel carved from jade that reflects the luster of the skies and the clear waters.
This famed blade was born in a nation to the far north. But in the name of "Isshin," it was stained with many a dark deed on its home-bound journey.
The bells used when performing the Kagura Dance, blessed by the Guuji herself. The scent of the Sacred Sakura tree lingers on it.
A blade that was once made in Tatarasuna. Heavy and tough.
One of a paired set of scepters fashioned from obsidian. They say that this can be used as a key to open the gate to a paradise that lies at the end of the ocean of sand.
weapons.ascension_material: Copper Talisman of the Forest Dew

weapons.official_english_description: A weapon you obtained from an Aranara tale. It has taken on the shape of a bow that can shoot the enemies of the forest down.
A special lance that was once used by a famed warrior who guarded the Tatarigami on Yashiori Island.
This gilded blade was made using precious white branches. It was once used to destroy countless poisons that infested the forest.
weapons.ascension_material: Copper Talisman of the Forest Dew

weapons.official_english_description: A legendary sword, said to be forged from the glimmering moonlight gathered in a well by an adeptus hidden among clear springs. Its true form is revealed only at the meeting of dusk and dawn.
A sharp blade with extravagant carvings that somehow does not compromise on durability and sharpness. It roars like a lion as it cuts through the air.
A greatsword carved and chiseled from the very bedrock of Liyue.
A spear forged from the rocks of the Guyun Stone Forest. Its hardness knows no equal.

weapons.official_english_name: Lost Prayer to the Sacred Winds
weapons.official_english_description: An educational tome written by anonymous early inhabitants who worshiped the wind. It has been blessed by the wind for its faithfulness and influence over the millennia.
A magnificent polearm adorned with azure crystal. It is said to have been a certain legendary Champion Duelist's treasure — and yet, not once was it ever used.
weapons.ascension_material: Broken Goblet of the Pristine Sea

weapons.official_english_description: The great king of the ocean. Having been air-dried, it makes for a fine weapon as well as emergency sustenance.
Version 12. A reprint featuring corrections to Version 11 and brand-new additions based on recent developments.
A graceful and elegant greatsword that is decorated with flowers and ribbons.
An ancient greatsword that gleams like the waters themselves. A thousand years of sand erosion has not dulled its unnaturally sharp edge one bit.
A nautical chart featuring nearby currents and climates that somehow found its way into Liyue via foreign traders.
A heavy greatsword with a razor-sharp blade. Power is a key that can open almost any lock.
weapons.ascension_material: Sundered Glory of the Far-North Scions

weapons.official_english_description: A stone dumbbell containing distant memories. Its endless transformations reveal the power within.
A basic wooden bow. It is said to have once been used as a tool for long-distance communication.
A beacon that shows the direction of the wind. Not every idyll carried on the breeze remains a gentle thing...
A sword that blazes with a fierce violet light. The name "Reforged" comes from it having been broken once before.
weapons.ascension_material: Coral Branch of a Distant Sea

weapons.official_english_description: A bow painted the color of transgression and nights of illusion.
A weapon you obtained from an Aranara tale. It is shaped like a giant arrow and can be used as a spear.

weapons.official_vietnamese_name: Bình Minh Của Người Dệt Trăng
weapons.official_english_description: An immaculate, sharp silver sword that can slice through armor like moonlight flowing through the empty night. According to legend, it is a divine blade, blessed by the first Moonchanter herself.
weapons.ascension_material: Sundered Glory of the Far-North Scions

weapons.official_english_description: This polearm was once jointly forged by the craftsmen in the mines as a sacrifice to the spirits of the mountains.
weapons.ascension_material: Delirious Decadence of the Sacred Lord

weapons.official_english_description: A lovely warbow made from seashells and coral. A mournful brilliance flows along its moonlight-colored arms.
A mirror crafted from flawless silver that is said to have witnessed the birth of the Moon Maiden. It is seen as a relic of unrivalled provenance by the Frostmoon Scions.
A jade pearl shrouded in the light of the moon. Even in the coldest winter night, its gentle warmth lingers like a song.
weapons.ascension_material: Sundered Glory of the Far-North Scions

weapons.official_english_description: A national treasure of Byakuyakoku stored in the Dainichi Mikoshi. With the coming of the Serpent God, this item was used to notarize great oaths and wishes.
weapons.ascension_material: Coral Branch of a Distant Sea

weapons.official_english_description: A battle-tested greatsword that has seen better days and worse.
A cheap fantasy novel with no value whatsoever. Any claim that it possesses the power of catalysis is also pure fantasy.
An obsidian blade of unparalleled sharpness, light as a song. It was modified by a certain artisan to come equipped with a record-playing detachable Phlogiston Device.
A carefully compiled notebook featuring the essentials needed to pass a magic exam.
A pristine bow that is as sharp as the glaciers of the far north.
An old-school power saw that you can rarely find nowadays. It was once a cutting tool trusted by workers all around.
weapons.ascension_material: Broken Goblet of the Pristine Sea

weapons.official_english_description: A uniquely-designed bow. This should not belong in this world.
A ceremonial sword masterfully carved from pure jade. There almost seems to be an audible sigh in the wind as it is swung.
A jade polearm made by the archons, capable of slaying ancient beasts.
A long-handled drill that you can rarely find nowadays. It was often used in delving and in carving stones.

A polearm that appears to have been crafted from a metal agricultural tool. At first glance, it could not look more ordinary, yet its discreet design hides fittings that are both lavish and undeniably exquisite.
A dully gilded catalyst secretly guarded in the Blackcliff Forge. It seems to glow with the very light from the sky.
An ancient greatsword discovered in the Blackcliff Forge. It swings with such an immense force that one feels it could cut straight through reality itself.
A prototype longbow discovered in the Blackcliff Forge. The arrow fired from this bow glimmers like a ray of moonlight.
An ancient longsword discovered in the Blackcliff Forge that cuts through rocks like a hot knife through butter.
A hooked spear discovered hidden away in the Blackcliff Forge. The glimmers along the sharp edge are like stars in the night.
An ancient ceremonial weapon passed down by the Masters of the Night-Wind. This dark bow is forever wreathed in an unshakable chill.
A fluorescent greatsword with no sharp edge that crushes enemies with brute force and raw power.
A measuring instrument that you can rarely find nowadays. It is capable of firing arrows.
Ravens are known to be the ferrymen of the dead. This bow's limb is decorated with raven feathers, which forebode the imminent death of its target.
It is said that this bow can shoot down eagles in flight, but ultimately how true that is depends on the skill of the archer.
According to its previous owner, this weapon is the "Mighty Redhorn Stoic Stonethreshing Gilded Goldcrushing Lion Lord" that can send any monster packing with its tail between its legs.
An angular box carved from gold and jade. Legend has it that it was once enshrined in a temple deep within Tulaytullah, the Sapphire City.
A sharp spear. Only its tip remains freshly bloodstained.
weapons.ascension_material: Broken Goblet of the Pristine Sea

weapons.official_english_description: This jade vessel was created by a hero of yesteryear. Legend has it that it once shot the giant dragon that dwelt in the volcano down from the skies.
weapons.ascension_material: Delirious Decadence of the Sacred Lord

weapons.official_english_description: An old longbow that belonged to the erstwhile aristocratic rulers of Mondstadt. Countless generations later, the bowstring is still tight and can still fire arrows with great force.
An old greatsword that belonged to the erstwhile rulers of Mondstadt. It is made from the finest-quality materials and has stood the test of time. A weapon for use by the nobility only.
A book that once belonged to a court mage of Mondstadt who served the nobility. It contains faithful and comprehensive historical accounts as well as magic spells.
An old longsword that belonged to the erstwhile rulers of Mondstadt. Exquisitely crafted, the carvings and embellishments testify to the stature of its owner.
This polearm was once cherished by a member of the old nobility that governed Mondstadt long ago. Although it has never seen the light of day, it is still incomparably sharp.
A completely rusted iron greatbow. The average person would lack the strength to even lift it, let alone fire it.
A silver-white polearm, pure and completely without blemish. Legend has it that it was used by the Archpriestesses of Hyperborea in ages past to guide their flock of Frostmoon Scions.
A ceremonial hunting bow that has become petrified over time. The trinkets on it are still visible. It grants the wielder the power to withstand the winds of time.
A weathered script, the text of which is no longer legible. A cursed item eroded by the winds of time.
A ceremonial greatsword that has become petrified over time. The trinkets on it are still visible. It grants the wielder the power to withstand the winds of time.
An ancient jade pendant that gleams like clear water. It seems to have been used in ancient ceremonies.
A ceremonial sword that has become petrified over time. The trinkets on it are still visible. It grants the wielder the power to withstand the winds of time.
A weapon you obtained from an Aranara tale. It has taken on the shape of a blade that can cut down the foes of the forest.
weapons.ascension_material: Copper Talisman of the Forest Dew

weapons.official_english_description: An ancient longbow that is a remnant of King Deshret's ancient era. An indecipherable ancient text and solemn patterns have been carved into it.
A bow that has been well-polished by time and meticulously cared for by its owner. It feels almost like an extension of the archer's arm.
A mechanical longbow purpose-built for long shots and silent kills. Its twang is swallowed up amidst the night, the note lengthy and cold.
A longsword forged from metal that makes a mournful sound when swung.
A rare weapon whose origin is the ancient ocean. One can hear the sound of the ageless waves as one swings it.
This superior bow once belonged to a master archer. However, it gives off a strong scent, thus making it unsuitable for hunting.
A sword for exorcising demons. Everyone knows it's made of a silver alloy, not pure silver.
Legendary bow of the fairies. Whether on the stage or the battlefield, it can easily touch the hearts of the listener.
A reliable steel sword. The legendary Skyrider once tried to ride it as a flying sword... for the second time.
A reliable steel sword. The legendary Skyrider once tried to ride it as a flying sword...
A cloud atlas symbolizing Dvalin and his former master, the Anemo Archon. It details the winds and clouds of the northern regions and contains the powers of the sky and wind.
The sword of a knight that symbolizes the restored honor of Dvalin. The blessings of the Anemo Archon rest on the fuller of the blade, imbuing the sword with the powers of the sky and the wind.
A greatbow that symbolizes Dvalin's affiliation with the Anemo Archon. The sound of the bow firing is music to the Anemo Archon's ears. It contains the power of the sky and wind within.
A claymore that symbolizes the pride of Dvalin soaring through the skies. When swung, it emits a deep hum as the full force of Dvalin's command of the sky and the wind is unleashed.
A polearm that symbolizes Dvalin's firm resolve. The upright shaft of this weapon points towards the heavens, clad in the might of sky and wind.
A bow, despite the name. After countless experiments and improvements to the design, the creator of the ultimate slingshot found himself to have made what was actually a bow.
The stave of this bow is comprised of metal alloy and yet remains surprisingly light. Even when faced with thick, heavy snares, the arrows it fires can pass through unhindered.
An ancient greatsword that was stored between frescoes. Forged from Starsilver, it has the power to cleave through ice and snow.
A dull, golden pearl made of an unknown substance that harbors the light of the sun and the moon and pulses with a warm strength.
A greatsword as light as the sigh of grass in the breeze, yet as merciless to the corrupt as a typhoon.
A strange longbow that resembles a sea creature. Its string makes no sound at all.
A long spear that once stood guard over all. Today, it has found a new purpose with children and their games of make-believe.
A scepter around which swirls pure water. In days long past, it once symbolized the highest authority over the seas.
A "firewood staff" that was once used in ancient and long-lost rituals.

One of a paired set of scepters fashioned from obsidian. Legend has it that these staves grant the right to lead the people of the desert, but no retainer now lives who can verify the proper appearance of these regalia.
A statue carved in the shape of an eagle, a sacred relic of the Masters of the Night-Wind that has been passed down from generation to generation.
weapons.ascension_material: Delirious Decadence of the Sacred Lord

weapons.official_english_description: A longsword made of bone that has only grown harder after being hit and swung countless times. It is said that this was the hero Wanjiru's reliable weapon.
A symbol of a legendary pact, this sharp blade once cut off the peak of a mountain.
A bell lantern forged from purple jade. They say it brings sweet dreams when placed beside one's pillow.

A commemorative item originally reserved for the champion of the "First All-Tribe Surfing Championship." Since said tournament is currently in the preparatory stage, the prize is in temporary storage at the Leisurely Puffer, with the shop owner as its custodian.
A sword of unique craftsmanship. It does not appear to belong to this world.
A sword whose power faded when the story ended. It will now embark upon a new journey with the power that remains within it, which commemorates a certain great dream.
An elegantly built polearm, said to have been a conductor's baton wielded by a great musician to bridge tune and taste.
Most people will find this obsidian-inlaid club quite convincing indeed.
Once upon a time, there was a youkai that roamed Inazuma in the form of a lantern's flame. This must once have been one of its vessels.
A straight sword as black as the night. It once belonged to a thief who roamed the benighted streets.
A heavy greatsword. A clock is embedded within it, though its internal mechanisms have long been damaged.
A pitch-black longsword that thirsts for violence and conflict. It is said that this weapon can cause its user to become drunk on the red wine of slaughter.
The songs of resistance come hither on the wind to settle as gentle tones upon these strings, their combined power great enough to rip boundless darkness asunder with the light of the breaking dawn.
A convenient cutting tool that you can rarely find nowadays. You can replace the blades as they are dulled by usage.
A stage prop once used by a past "Great Magician." Its final secret was that it was also a weapon beyond the pale.
Beneath its rusty exterior is a lavishly decorated thin blade. It swings as swiftly as the wind.
A bow that once served as an extraordinary instrument. It is no longer capable of getting people up and dancing.
Capable of driving away evil spirits and wicked people alike, this edgeless claymore seems to possess divine might.
A pure green hunting bow. This once belonged to a certain hunter whose home was the forest.
A heavy notebook filled with musical scores. Though suffering from moth damage and heavy wear-and-tear, there is still much power to be found among the hand-written words within.
A fictional story of a band of five heroes who go off on a dragon hunt. It is poorly written and structurally incoherent. Its value lies in the many lessons that can be learned from failure.
A longbow that was a gift from the Shogun. Eternal lightning crackles all around it.
An exquisitely-crafted, standard-model sword forged for the high-ranking officers and flagship captains of Fontaine's old navy.
weapons.ascension_material: Broken Goblet of the Pristine Sea

weapons.official_vietnamese_name: Nghi Thức Dòng Chảy Vĩnh Hằng
weapons.official_english_description: A manual that was once passed down from generation to generation within an underwater priory. Today, none know of its existence.
A rather special oil-paper umbrella. While long wanderings may make one used to the wind and the rain, there might be some fun in admiring a rainy scene beneath this parasol.
A handy steel sword which contains scissors, a magnifying glass, tinder, and other useful items in its sheath.
A bell crafted of deep sapphire and sterling silver. Its echoes are as crisp as they are distant.
A jade pendant formed by piecing together two jade stones.
This famous blade was once created by the hand of Urakusai, the renowned literatus. Legend has it that it has never cut any living creature in all these hundreds of years.
weapons.ascension_material: Coral Branch of a Distant Sea

weapons.official_english_description: A weapon once used by a young maiden who forsook her family name, stained with the blood of enemies and loved ones both.
A trophy made from gemstones from the Collective of Plenty and crystals from the Flower-Feather Clan. It is said to have once belonged to a legendary wrestler.
weapons.ascension_material: Delirious Decadence of the Sacred Lord

weapons.official_english_description: This sharp polearm can seemingly pierce through anything. When swung, one can almost see the rift it tears in the air.
This was originally a device used by researchers to observe and perform calculations on celestial phenomena. It serves as a conduit and catalyst.
A sturdy sheet of iron that may be powerful enough to break apart mountains if wielded with enough willpower.
A naginata forged from luminescent material deep in the ocean depths. It was once the possession of the tengu race.
A boomerang made from the fangs of a giant sea serpent. It was a rare weapon indeed that the giant Tupac would call "trusty."

A claymore made from white iron. Lightweight without compromising on power. Effective even when wielded by one of average strength, it is extremely deadly in the hands of a physically stronger wielder.
A standard-issue weapon of the Millelith soldiers. It has a sturdy shaft and sharp spearhead. It's a reliable weapon.
An exotic sword with one section of the blade left blunt. It made its way into Liyue via the hands of foreign traders. Incredibly powerful in the hands of someone who knows how to use it.
A longsword light as the feathers of a snow swan, and which stays pure and untainted at all times.
weapons.ascension_material: Measured Pour of the Cellared Spiritual Nectar

weapons.official_english_description: A bow adorned with nameless flowers that bears the earnest hopes of an equally nameless person.

weapons.official_vietnamese_name: Rượu Và Thơ Nơi Hẻm Tối
weapons.official_english_description: A songbook from the bygone aristocratic era, whose composer has become forgotten. It chronicles the tale of a certain heroic outlaw.

A longsword used by the Wolf Knight. Originally just a heavy sheet of iron given to the knight by a blacksmith from the city, it became endowed with legendary power owing to his friendship with the wolves.
Legend has it that this longsword was once used by a wandering knight in the distant past.
This ancient double-edged sword glimmers with moonlight. It is said that a now-silent Jinni dwells within it.
weapons.ascension_material: Copper Talisman of the Forest Dew
